title: Structure and mechanical properties of novel lightweight refractory high entropy alloys NbMoTiZr-(Al/V): A combined first principles and experimental study
process_description: prepared by WK-II non-selfconsuming vacuum arc furnace with a purity of 99.9%, rotated and melted at least 7 times, kept in liquid state for 10 min during each melting process to ensure homogeneous composition
